name: Repair & Resilience Library
actions: search and inspect 100 independently verified repair and resilience prototypes plus one separately labeled authored integration helper
load a named component through a bounded local Node.js API
rerun one or all packaged component self-tests on explicit request
preserve each source seed's experimental status, empty permissions and non-escalating authority
summary: A searchable, loadable local library for 100 verified repair and resilience seeds plus one authored observe-only integration helper, with their original experimental posture and authority boundaries intact.
notes: The library wrapper is WORKING. Its 100 contained seeds remain EXPERIMENTAL 0.1.0 until separately proven in live scenarios and promoted by Mike. The health telemetry helper is labeled separately because its source has code and a self-test but no seed manifest or contract. Loading a surface grants no repair, install, process, network, publication, promotion, or CANON authority.
